_: The Apple apps release-apple.yml ships to TestFlight and, as an unsigned IPA, to the AltStore and SideStore sources, keyed by the tag prefix (desk-v1.2.3, phone-v1.2.3). bundleId is what the bundle check and the source use; icon is copied into the feeds site. docs/ship/release.md, docs/ship/feeds.md.

desk.subtitle: The household calendar on an iPad
desk.description: Earthshade on the iPad: the household calendar, the day sheet and the voice assistant, paired with your own Earthshade service.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: The front camera notices who is at the desk and greets them; nothing it sees there is saved or sent. It also takes a person's photo for their circle, only when you choose Take a photo, and that photo is sent to your household's service.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone listens for your voice only while someone is at the desk. Nothing is recorded.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Your words are turned into text on this iPad so the calendar can answer. Audio never leaves it.

phone.subtitle: The household calendar on an iPhone
phone.description: Earthshade on the iPhone: your household calendar, paired with your own Earthshade service.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: To scan the square on your wall.
